def transform(grid):
    """Translate all non-background cells down one row, clipping the last row."""
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[background] * width for _ in range(height)]
    for r in range(height - 1):
        out[r + 1] = list(grid[r])
    return out
